build_CSPDarknet_P5: build a CSPDarknet P5 backbone model with default deepen and widen factors for object detection
build_CSPDarknet_P6: build a CSPDarknet P6 backbone model with five stages for higher resolution feature extraction
create_Focus_module: create a Focus module to split and concatenate spatial patches into channel dimension

review_CSPDarknet_forward: review the CSPDarknet forward pass that returns multi-scale feature maps from selected output indices
